text: Company leave policy: Employees are required to provide 30 days written notice for resignation. For bereavement leave, 5 days notice is required. Annual leave requires 14 days advance notice.
Sick leave policy: Employees may take up to 10 sick days per year. A medical certificate is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Sick days cannot be carried over to the next year.

Invoice requirements: All invoices must include vendor name, tax identification number, itemized list of services or products, applicable tax rate, subtotal, and total amount due. Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

Probation period: New employees serve a 90-day probation period. Performance reviews occur at 30, 60, and 90 days. Successful completion of probation leads to permanent employment status and full benefits eligibility.

Remote work policy: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Full remote work requires VP-level approval and a signed remote work agreement. Equipment must be returned upon termination.

Service agreement terms: Contracts are effective for 12 months from the date of signing. Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice. Late payments incur a 1.5% monthly service charge on the outstanding balance.

Expense reimbursement: Employees must submit expense reports within 30 days of incurring the expense. Receipts are required for all purchases over $25. International travel expenses require pre-approval from the finance department.

Benefits eligibility: Full-time employees are eligible for health insurance, dental coverage, and 401(k) matching after 60 days of employment. Part-time employees working 30 or more hours per week receive proportional benefits.

Password policy: All passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters. Passwords must be changed every 90 days. Previous 12 passwords cannot be reused.

Non-disclosure agreement: The receiving party agrees to maintain confidentiality of all proprietary information for a period of 5 years after termination of the agreement. This includes trade secrets, client lists, and financial data.

Onboarding process: New employees must complete I-9 verification, sign the employee handbook acknowledgment, complete safety training, and set up their workstation within the first week. Required documents include government-issued photo ID, Social Security card, and proof of eligibility to work.
Sick leave policy: Employees may take up to 10 sick days per year. A medical certificate is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Sick days cannot be carried over.
Vacation policy: Employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month of employment, up to 20 days per year. Vacation requests must be submitted 2 weeks in advance. Unused vacation days expire at year end.
